# Sumber data dan rujukan {#sec-referensi}

Sitasi dataset yang Anda pakai, bukan hanya perangkat lunaknya.

## Citra dan produk satelit

| Dataset | ID Earth Engine | Rujukan |
|---------|-----------------|---------|
| Sentinel-2 SR | `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED` | Copernicus / ESA |
| Sentinel-1 GRD | `COPERNICUS/S1_GRD` | Copernicus / ESA |
| Landsat C2-L2 | `LANDSAT/LC08|LC09/C02/T1_L2`, `LT05` | USGS / NASA |
| MODIS luas terbakar | `MODIS/061/MCD64A1` | Giglio dkk. |
| MODIS LST | `MODIS/061/MOD11A2` | NASA LP DAAC |
| FIRMS titik api aktif | `FIRMS` | NASA FIRMS |
| Sentinel-5P aerosol | `COPERNICUS/S5P/*/L3_AER_AI` | Copernicus / ESA |
| SRTM | `CGIAR/SRTM90_V4` | Jarvis dkk. |

## Populasi, permukiman, iklim

| Dataset | ID / sumber | Rujukan |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| GHSL populasi | `JRC/GHSL/P2023A/GHS_POP` | EU JRC — Schiavina dkk. |
| GHSL terbangun | `JRC/GHSL/P2023A/GHS_BUILT_S` | EU JRC |
| WorldPop | via GEE | WorldPop, Univ. Southampton |
| NOAA OISST | `NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1` | Huang dkk. |
| ERA5 | `ECMWF/ERA5*` | Hersbach dkk., ECMWF |
| CAMS (PM2.5) | `ECMWF/CAMS/NRT` | CAMS / ECMWF |
| FAO GAUL | `FAO/GAUL/2015/level1`, `level2` | FAO |

## Gambut dan tanah

**Gumbricht, T., Román-Cuesta, R. M., Verchot, L. V., Herold, M., Wittmann, F.,
Householder, E., Herold, N., & Murdiyarso, D.** (2017). An expert system model for
mapping tropical wetlands and peatlands reveals South America as the largest
contributor. *Global Change Biology*, 23(9), 3581–3599.
Data: <https://doi.org/10.17528/CIFOR/DATA.00058>

**Widyastuti, M. T., Minasny, B., Padarian, J., & Maggi, F.** (2024). PEATGRIDS:
Mapping global peat thickness and carbon stock via digital soil mapping.
Aset GEE: `projects/sat-io/open-datasets/PEATGRIDS/*`

**OpenLandMap** karbon organik tanah:
`OpenLandMap/SOL/SOL_ORGANIC-CARBON_USDA-6A1C_M/v02`

## Metode

**Stull, R.** (2011). Wet-bulb temperature from relative humidity and air
temperature. *Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology*, 50(11), 2267–2269.
— rumus wet-bulb yang dipakai `island-heat`.

**Key, C. H., & Benson, N. C.** (2006). Landscape assessment (LA): sampling and
analysis methods. USDA Forest Service. — dasar dNBR dan peringatan bahwa ambang
severity idealnya dikalibrasi lapangan.

## Perangkat lunak

**forge3d** — render 3D GPU (Rust/WebGPU) oleh Miloš Popović:
<https://github.com/milos-agathon/forge3d>

Gaya poster paku populasi pada @sec-populasi terinspirasi peta populasi GHSL karya
Miloš Popović (<https://milosgis.com>).
